title: What would you like to set up first?
lead: Pick one to open its setup. Choosing here doesn’t add a role to your account — you can set up the others later.

fighter.title: Fighter
fighter.body: Train, track progress and connect. Free forever for the core app.

coach.title: Coach
coach.body: Manage fighters, programs and fight camps.

gym.title: Gym / Club
gym.body: Manage members, coaches and your boxing business.

sponsor.title: Sponsor / Brand
sponsor.body: Partner with the boxing community — challenges, events, gyms.
sponsor.note: Partner application · reviewed by our team

account.title: One account
account.body: Fighter, coach, gym owner and sponsor are roles you can set up on the same account. This choice only decides where you start.

notSaved: Your pick isn’t saved. Leave now and we’ll ask again next time.

failure.title: We couldn’t open that setup.
failure.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing changed on your account.
failure.unexpected: This version of SimpleFit can’t open it yet. Reload the page and try again.
